name: Squad Tactics (Combat, Teamwork)
body:
You excel when close to allies using firearms.

Prerequisite(s): Weapon Focus (any firearm), base attack bonus +3

Benefit(s): You receive a +1 competence bonus on attack and damage rolls with your chosen firearm as long as you are within 10 feet of an ally who possesses this feat.
